diagnostic.note: Diagnostic denominator includes goodwill and acquired intangibles; excludes subtracting noncash investments, so conservative. End-year, not average capital. Not a reported metric; not used to add back R&D to DCF.

Diagnostic denominator includes goodwill and acquired intangibles; excludes subtracting noncash investments, so conservative. End-year, not average capital. Not a reported metric; not used to add back R&D to DCF.

rationale: Five-year R&D-capitalized, acquisition-inclusive diagnostic tempers superficially high asset-light book returns. Base 15% is below recent diagnostic; upside 20% requires durable moat/monetization; downside 10% is below the 12% downside WACC by 2 percentage points, so incremental terminal growth destroys value relative to capital cost. Terminal reinvestment g/ROIC is charged, never assumed zero.
limitations: Five-year life is analyst assumption, not proof of economic research life; terminal return remains an explicit scenario input.
v3_comparability: Historical return diagnostic uses reported amortized SBC, while v3 economic margins charge annual new-grant value. It is therefore a reasonableness anchor rather than an exact same-compensation-basis ROIC. Neither the recent Hexagon purchase nor its future returns are proven by the2024–25 diagnostic. Terminal assumptions remain conditional.
